news.title: White Horse 3Q FY2026 swings to RM5.051m profit on RM10.0m property disposal gain, but 9M still a RM4.921m net loss

recent_en: WTHORSE announced on 19 Nov 2026 its quarterly results for the period ended 30 Sep 2026, swinging to a RM5.051 million profit in 3Q on a RM10.0 million property disposal gain, but remaining in a RM4.921 million net loss for 9M. The company has been continuously buying back shares and saw several board and committee changes. Separately, a winding-up / receiver / restraining order / special administrator announcement was made on 23 Oct.
notable_en: 3Q swung to a RM5.051 million profit on a RM10.0 million property disposal gain, but 9M remained a RM4.921 million net loss.
The company announced a winding-up / receiver / restraining order / special administrator matter on 23 Oct.
risks_en: 9M remained a net loss of RM4.921 million.
A winding-up / receiver / restraining order / special administrator announcement was made on 23 Oct.
